description:
Use this when the user wants to add a person to their RipClip team: "invite my editor", "add
sam@example.com to my team". It emails the invite to another person, so confirm the address with the user
first. Only an account with team seats can invite; 20 invites an hour, each lasts 7 days.
Not for: removing a member (done in RipClip) or the share link (get_invite_link). Free: no Horizon Units.

email.description: The invited person's email address, e.g. sam@example.com.

name: invite_team_member
title: Invite someone to my team
